close_reason: fixed: rfc3339_to_epoch_secs takes &str, no String allocation per email
description: mod.rs:119-122 — sort_thread_email_ids calls .to_owned() on the receivedAt &str before passing it to rfc3339_to_epoch_secs, allocating a heap String per email solely to satisfy the &String argument. rfc3339_to_epoch_secs takes &str; the intermediate String can be dropped. For long-lived mailing-list threads (1000+ emails) triggered on every import, this is N unnecessary heap allocations per thread sort.
title: sort_thread_email_ids: String clone per email for rfc3339 parse
